android.desc:
Redecor - Home Design Game does not require payment to download and play, but it also allows you to purchase virtual items with real money inside the game, including random items. 

Welcome, Redecorator! Ready to unleash your inner designer? 🌟 Dive into Redecor – Home Design Game and turn your interior design dreams into reality! 🏡💭 

Explore a world of endless creativity and excitement! ✨ Whether you’re a seasoned designer or just starting out, Redecor is the perfect home design game if you’re seeking a relaxing and creative way to express your style, improve your home design skills, and create your dream home! 🌿 Gain inspiration from a vibrant community, experiment with various design styles, and apply your creations in real life. 🖌️ With lifelike rooms complete with 3D graphics, Redecor guarantees an exciting design experience for everyone! 🌟 

Main Features: 

Monthly Seasonal Themes & Items: 🎨 

• Every month, explore and master different design styles with our seasonal themes. From Boho Chic to Wabi Sabi, there’s a design style for everyone to unleash their creativity through a multitude of rooms! PLUS, become a Season Pass Holder and enjoy: 

○ 4+ Designs per day: 📅 Daily inspiration for your next masterpiece. 

○ 7 Redesigns per Design: 🔄 Perfect your creations with multiple iterations. 

○ Extra Level Up Rewards: 🎁 Earn additional rewards as you progress. 

○ Unique Seasonal Items: 🎄 Access exclusive seasonal decor. 

○ 12+ Season Pass-only Designs: 🛋️ Unlock designs available only to Season Pass holders. 

○ Special Redecor Events: 🏆 Participate in themed events and competitions. 

Designer Status: 🌟 

• Level up in your Designer Status and earn the extra rewards, items, and benefits you truly deserve! Make it to the very top by reaching the Icon Designer Status! 🏆 

Daily Design Challenges: 🗓️ 

Participate in daily design challenges across two different gaming modes: 

• My Design Journal: 📔 Explore themed and educational designs without any time pressure. Design at your own pace, fill in your journal to reach milestones, and unlock rewards! 

• Live Tab: 🎉 Dive into design challenges with themes based on seasonal and in-game events. Each challenge includes client briefs and specific design requirements, from fashion, food, and more! 

Global Voting: 🌍

quotes.text:
I'm completely convinced that the voting in Redecor - Home Design Game[1] is completely random. What they've done is Skinner boxed their competitions in a way that more or less evenly distributes random rewards to maximize engagement rather than reward players based on merit. It has the veneer of a voting-based competition, but none of the real guts of one.

1. https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=fi.reworks.redecor&hl=en_US&gl=US
